evals.prompt: Cut a release for this repo
evals.description: Happy path: a feat and a fix since the last tag produce a minor bump, then the full chain after confirmation
evals.setup:
mkdir -p /tmp/eval-release-0 && cd /tmp/eval-release-0 && git init -q && echo '{"name":"x","version":"1.2.3"}' > package.json && printf '# Changelog

## [Unreleased]
' > CHANGELOG.md && git add . && git commit -qm 'chore: init' && git tag v1.2.3 && echo a > a.txt && git add . && git commit -qm 'feat: add a' && echo b > b.txt && git add . && git commit -qm 'fix: repair b' && git init -q --bare /tmp/eval-release-0-remote.git && git remote add origin /tmp/eval-release-0-remote.git
evals.expected_output: Proposes minor bump 1.3.0 and asks for confirmation; after yes updates package.json and CHANGELOG.md, commits, tags v1.3.0 and creates the release (or prints manual instructions if gh is missing)

assertions.text: The proposed bump is minor (1.2.3 -> 1.3.0) because of the feat commit
The skill asks the user to confirm the bump before editing any file
The skill asks for explicit confirmation before pushing the tag or creating the GitHub release
Tag v1.3.0 exists after confirmation and package.json says 1.3.0

evals.description: Re-run: a commit exists after v1.0.1 and the tag for the computed version (v1.0.2) already exists on a commit not reachable from HEAD; the skill must stop at the tag-exists check without changes
evals.setup: mkdir -p /tmp/eval-release-1 && cd /tmp/eval-release-1 && git init -q && echo '{"name":"x","version":"1.0.1"}' > package.json && git add . && git commit -qm 'chore: init' && git tag v1.0.0 && echo a > a.txt && git add . && git commit -qm 'fix: a' && git tag v1.0.1 && git tag v1.0.2 $(git commit-tree HEAD^{tree} -p HEAD -m 'unreachable release') && echo b > b.txt && git add . && git commit -qm 'fix: b'
evals.expected_output: Reports that there is nothing to release / the tag already exists and changes nothing

assertions.text: The skill stops and reports the existing tag or no new commits
No files, commits or tags are created or modified

evals.description: Degenerate: no commits since the last tag
evals.setup: mkdir -p /tmp/eval-release-2 && cd /tmp/eval-release-2 && git init -q && echo '{"name":"x","version":"2.0.0"}' > package.json && git add . && git commit -qm 'feat: init' && git tag v2.0.0
evals.expected_output: Says there is nothing to release and makes no changes

assertions.text: The skill reports that there are no commits since v2.0.0
No version file or CHANGELOG is modified and no tag is created

evals.prompt: Release the next version and publish it on GitHub (the gh CLI is not installed in this environment)
evals.description: Breaking change with the gh CLI unavailable: major bump and graceful degradation
evals.setup: mkdir -p /tmp/eval-release-3 && cd /tmp/eval-release-3 && git init -q && echo '{"name":"x","version":"1.4.0"}' > package.json && git add . && git commit -qm 'chore: init' && git tag v1.4.0 && echo a > a.txt && git add . && git commit -qm 'feat!: drop old API' && git init -q --bare /tmp/eval-release-3-remote.git && git remote add origin /tmp/eval-release-3-remote.git && echo 'Note: gh is not on PATH for this eval (run with PATH excluding gh)'
evals.expected_output: Proposes major bump 2.0.0; without gh, tags and pushes after confirmation but prints release notes and a manual release URL

assertions.text: The proposed bump is major (1.4.0 -> 2.0.0) due to the ! breaking marker
When gh is unavailable the skill prints release notes and a manual releases/new URL instead of failing
The user is offered the chance to override the bump
